title: Test Lead
jobDescription: Job Summary Serve as a Test Lead with eight to twelve years of experience guiding end to end testing for Facets configurations and Oracle SQL based validations in a hybrid work model. Coordinate day shift test planning execution and defect resolution to improve payer related solutions enhance member and provider outcomes and support overall organizational quality goals. Responsibilities Lead comprehensive test planning for Facets plan product and benefits capabilities to ensure accurate configuration coverage across multiple functional scenarios and payer processes. Oversee creation of detailed test scenarios and test cases for Facets benefit configuration by translating business requirements into clear and testable conditions that minimize gaps and rework. Coordinate day to day test execution activities for Oracle SQL and Facets components by organizing workloads tracking progress and driving timely completion of assigned testing cycles. Validate Facets plan product and benefit setup using Oracle SQL queries by comparing configured data with source requirements to detect inconsistencies and integration defects. Perform functional and regression testing on Facets modules by focusing on member benefits product rules and claims related flows to protect system stability during releases. Collaborate with business analysts and configuration specialists by clarifying requirements discussing edge cases and ensuring that test coverage reflects real world payer operations. Review and refine test data strategies for Facets benefit configuration by defining reusable data sets that support complex plan designs while reducing manual test preparation effort. Analyze test results and production like defects by identifying root causes proposing corrective actions and supporting continuous improvement of configuration and development practices. Document test evidence execution status and defect details in the test management tool by maintaining clear and audit ready records that support quality and compliance expectations. Partner with cross functional teams in the hybrid work model by using structured communication routines that keep stakeholders informed about risks issues and release readiness. Contribute to estimation and test effort planning by assessing scope complexity and dependencies so that commitments are realistic and aligned with project timelines. Guide and support junior testers on Facets and Oracle SQL topics by sharing knowledge reviewing work products and encouraging consistent adherence to testing standards. Align testing practices with organizational quality objectives by focusing on defect prevention reliable payer services and improved experiences for members and providers. Qualifications Show eight to twelve years of progressive experience in software testing with significant exposure to health care systems and complex enterprise platforms. Demonstrate strong hands on expertise in Oracle SQL by writing and optimizing queries that support data validation reconciliation and investigation of configuration defects. Exhibit deep working experience with Facets plan product functionality by understanding how products plans and related attributes drive payer business rules and outcomes. Apply practical knowledge of Facets benefits and benefit configuration by designing and validating intricate benefit structures accumulators and coverage rules. Display familiarity with broader Facets capabilities by navigating key modules interpreting configuration dependencies and supporting end to end test flows. Bring helpful domain understanding of payer operations by relating test scenarios to claims processing eligibility benefits usage and regulatory expectations. Utilize strong analytical and problem solving skills by breaking down complex issues recognizing patterns and selecting appropriate testing techniques. Communicate clearly in verbal and written form by preparing concise test reports defect descriptions and stakeholder updates that support informed decisions. Adapt effectively to a hybrid work model and day shift expectations by managing time collaborating through virtual tools and maintaining consistent delivery quality. Certifications Required ISTQB Foundation or equivalent testing certification preferred and any Oracle database or SQL certification is an added advantage.

title: Hardware Test Engineer
jobDescription: Job Description – Hardware Test Engineer Position: Hardware Test Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: 5–8 Years Job Summary Hardware Test Engineer with experience in hardware testing, test setup preparation, test report generation, schematic design, and PCB layout review. The candidate will be responsible for designing, validating, testing, and improving electronic hardware systems while ensuring compliance with quality and performance requirements. Key Responsibilities Design and develop electronic hardware circuits and subsystems based on product requirements. Prepare and configure hardware test setups for board-level and system-level validation. Execute functional, electrical, environmental, EMIEMC and performance testing of hardware products. Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare detailed test reports and technical documentation. Create and modify schematics. Conduct PCB layout reviews to ensure signal integrity, power integrity, manufacturability, and compliance with design guidelines. Collaborate with firmware, software, mechanical, and manufacturing teams during product development. Support prototype bring-up, debugging, and validation activities. Ensure adherence to engineering standards, quality processes, and regulatory requirements. Required Skills Strong knowledge of analog and digital circuit design. Hands-on experience in hardware testing and validation. Experience in preparing and maintaining test setups and test environments. Expertise in test report preparation and documentation. knowledge in schematic design tools such as Altium Designer, Or CAD, Cadence, or similar. Experience in PCB layout review and design verification. Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as Oscilloscopes, Logic Analyzers, Power Supplies, Function Generators, and Multimeters. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Good understanding of EMC/EMI, signal integrity, and power integrity concepts. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering or related field. Experience with embedded hardware platforms and microcontrollers. Knowledge of manufacturing processes and DFM/DFT principles. Familiarity with compliance standards and product certification processes. Key Competencies Analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills. Attention to detail and documentation excellence. Effective communication and teamwork. Ability to work independently in a fast-paced development environment.

Mandatory Requirements Overall 5+ years of QA/Testing experience Minimum 3 years of Airline domain experience Hands-on experience working with one or more of the following: Amadeus Sabre Galileo Travelport Departure Control Systems (DCS) Global Distribution Systems (GDS) Strong experience in: Web Automation Testing API Automation Testing End-to-end Test Automation Frameworks Good understanding of airline business processes including: Passenger Reservation Ticketing Check-in Boarding Flight Operations Ancillary Services Technical Skills Selenium UI, Web and mobile automation API Automation using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate, or equivalent tools Java / Java Script / Type Script Test NG, JUnit, BDD Frameworks (Cucumber) CI/CD Tools (Jenkins, Azure Dev Ops, Git Hub Actions) Git Version Control SQL and Database Validation Defect Tracking using JIRA or similar tools Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for web and API applications. Validate airline business-critical workflows within DCS, GDS, Amadeus, and Sabre environments. Build automated test suites for reservation, ticketing, check-in, boarding, and airport operations modules. Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and product teams to ensure quality deliverables. Execute regression, functional, integration, and API testing. Analyze automation results, identify defects, and support issue resolution. Drive automation best practices and improve test coverage. Preferred Skills Exposure to airline airport operations and passenger service workflows. Experience working directly with airline carriers or travel technology providers. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. Understanding of cloud-based testing environments. Priority will be given to candidates with hands-on automation experience in Amadeus, Sabre, DCS, or GDS platforms and strong exposure to airline passenger servicing and airport operations.
